key.name: mode
key.summary: off: no recording; manual: Record button in the call screen; auto-all: every call; auto-contacts: calls with the numbers in auto-contacts

key.name: auto-contacts
key.summary: Phone numbers recorded automatically in auto-contacts mode

key.name: sample-rate
key.summary: Recording rate in Hz; 0 = the call's native rate (48000 when unknown)

key.name: announce
key.summary: Play a short tone into the call (uplink, where possible) when recording starts

key.name: notice-accepted
key.summary: The first-use notice (recording laws differ by country) was acknowledged

key.name: fallback
key.summary: When no call tap exists, record the microphone and the speaker output instead (labelled "fallback")

key.name: debug-record-all
key.summary: Test sessions: record every call, whatever the mode
